description: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu directed officials to use AI, blockchain, data lakes and other technologies to simplify online government services. He also reviewed the Kharif crop outlook, water supply, dengue prevention and renewable energy measures during a secretariat meeting
body_lead: Home |News |Andhra Pradesh To Leverage Ai Blockchain For Easier Government Services Naidu Andhra Pradesh to leverage AI, blockchain for easier government services: Naidu Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu directed officials to use AI, blockchain, data lakes and other technologies to simplify online government services.
